correctness.rationale: The hub-and-leaf coalition formula gives vα(h∪K)=αsum_{i∈K}w_i+(1−α)min_{j∉K}w_j. Singleton leaf and complementary-leaf core inequalities give each 0≤x_i≤(2α−1)w_i; for α≥1/2 their product box and efficiency imply every remaining coalition constraint using sum omitted weights≥min omitted. The external unanimity-game telescoping expansion yields leaf Shapley component b_i; internal edge unanimity gives αw_i/2. Writing r_i=b_i/w_i and using summation-by-parts proves r1≥...≥rm≥−1/(m+1); thus first leaf uniquely sets upper-box entry threshold α*=(1+r1)/(3/2+r1). Equality at equal weights and the m=2 formula follow algebraically. Compare marginal of maximum-weight leaf at {hub} versus N\{i} to violate supermodularity for α<1. Inspected standalone exact-rational trust_star_check.py and independently computed two-leaf weights (1/2,1) cutoff 5/8 with all coalition checks; these finite computations corroborate the all-real-weight symbolic proof.
